--- a/base/executors/common.py

@@ -305,7 +305,14 @@ class DeviceLease:
             paths = sorted(set(self.root / name for name in names) | set(self.compatibility_paths))
             for path in paths:
                 name = str(path)
-                fd = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o666)
+                # In a sticky directory, Linux protected_regular can reject an
+                # O_CREAT open of another user's existing lock even for root.
+                # Create exclusively; open existing files without O_CREAT.
+                # O_NOFOLLOW and the fstat checks still reject unsafe targets.
+                try:
+                    fd = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o666)
+                except FileExistsError:
+                    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
                 info = os.fstat(fd)
                 if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1:
                     os.close(fd)
